definitions: A cessation of movement or operation.
A place where a vehicle, such as a bus or train, regularly halts.
A device or plug used to obstruct an opening.
A punctuation mark, especially a full stop.
A set of organ pipes of a particular tone colour.
examples: The bus came to a sudden stop.
I'll meet you at the next bus stop.
Put a stop to this nonsense.
He pulled out all the stops.
